description: This file defines the SoapResourceObserver class, which extends ResourceObserver and is responsible for handling SOAP responses related to resource management errors within the SuiteCRM application. The class includes methods to set a SOAP server instance and to notify SOAP clients of errors by generating a SOAP fault response.

classes.name: SoapResourceObserver
classes.description: A class that extends ResourceObserver to handle SOAP-based notifications for resource errors in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the SoapResourceObserver with the specified module by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: set_soap_server
methods.description: Sets the SOAP server instance that will be used to send responses to SOAP clients.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends a SOAP error response to the client indicating a resource management error, including setting appropriate HTTP headers and serializing the SOAP fault.
